picks.headline: Fender Studio Pro 8.1 review: an AI-loaded DAW
picks.rationale: A full DAW baking in a Studio Assistant chatbot, best-in-class Moises stem separation and vocal replacement/tuning — directly changes how producers work day to day.
picks.excerpt: Fender's Studio Pro 8.1 DAW folds in a suite of AI features — a beta Studio Assistant chatbot, Moises-powered stem separation and generation, voice replacement and Vocal Tune pitch correction — with the review calling the Moises stem quality among the best it has heard.

picks.headline: Can Meaw Chain make 'vibe mixing' a thing?
picks.rationale: Builds an effects chain from a natural-language prompt — a genuinely new interaction model for mixing, high novelty and directly actionable at the desk.
picks.excerpt: Meaw Chain is an AI-powered plugin that analyses your audio and assembles a suitable chain of effects from a natural-language text prompt — pitching 'vibe mixing' as a way to build processing chains by describing the sound you want rather than dialling in each plugin by hand.

picks.headline: IK Multimedia adds Brazilian voices to its ReSing AI vocal engine
picks.rationale: A concrete new AI-vocals release — turn a scratch vocal into a pro performance in a new language — from a credible maker; adds outlet and craft-tool diversity.
picks.excerpt: IK Multimedia expands its ReSing AI vocal-synthesis platform with eight new Brazilian Portuguese voice models, letting producers turn a scratch vocal into a professional-sounding performance in a new language — a fresh AI-vocals craft tool, launched alongside a Singer Showcase discovery platform.

picks.headline: TIDAL will label AI-generated music and block it from earning royalties
picks.rationale: A concrete platform policy — not just an industry proposal — flagging fully AI-generated tracks and cutting their royalties; distinct actor and payment angle vs the earlier RIAA/Spotify labeling items.
picks.excerpt: TIDAL will begin labeling tracks it determines are entirely AI-generated and will block them from earning royalties, prioritizing payouts for music 'directly produced, written, and performed by people' — a policy that directly affects how AI-music creators distribute and get paid.
